_comment: Context window (max input tokens) per model, for the live-status 'ctx used/window' readout. Keys are matched as substrings of the model id (e.g. 'opus' matches claude-opus-4-8). Edit as models change; 'default' is used when no key matches.
_prices_comment: USD per 1M tokens (input, output). Cache read billed ~0.1x input, cache write ~1.25x input — applied automatically to the estimate. Keys matched as substrings of the model id.
